# Fix Empty/White Startup Screen

## Overview

Users see a white/light native launch surface before Flutter's dark splash screen appears. Root cause: Android and iOS native launch surfaces are configured white/light (#FFFFFF), while the Flutter `SplashScreen` widget uses dark (#030303). Pre-`runApp()` async work (`Supabase`, `SharedPreferences`, `PackageInfo`) extends time on the white native surface.

**Investigation**: `docs/investigations/20260321174500_investigation_empty_white_startup_screen.md`

## Scope

1. **Native launch surfaces → dark #030303** (Android + iOS)
2. **Defer `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` after `runApp()`** to reduce pre-render wait

Out of scope: Supabase/SharedPreferences deferral, flutter_native_splash package adoption, animated native splash.

## Key Decisions

- **Color**: Exactly `#030303` via custom `colors.xml` / explicit storyboard RGB — NOT `@android:color/black` (#000000), which is perceptibly different on OLED
- **DI strategy**: Await `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` at top of `initializeApp()`, pass to `buildModules()` — preserves existing registration pattern, removes from constructor chain
- **PackageInfo failure**: Caught by existing `try/catch` in `initializeApp()` → error screen with retry (consistent behavior)
- **Android 12+**: Create `values-v31` + `values-night-v31` with `windowSplashScreenBackground`; add `setOnExitAnimationListener` in `MainActivity.kt` to prevent fade flicker
- **Night mode**: Create `drawable-night/launch_background.xml` for future-proofing

## Quick commands

```bash
# Build and run on iOS simulator (clear cache first)
flutter clean && flutter pub get && flutter run -d 1EA9596A-EBDF-4B22-9781-181F20DEB836 --dart-define-from-file=env/env.json

# Analyze
flutter analyze

# Run tests
flutter test
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] No white flash visible on cold start (Android pre-12, Android 12+, iOS)
- [ ] Native launch surface matches Flutter splash background (#030303)
- [ ] `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` no longer blocks `runApp()`
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] Retry initialization path still works (error → retry → success)

## References

- Flutter Android splash docs: https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/android/splash-screen
- Flutter iOS splash docs: https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/ios/splash-screen
- Android 12 SplashScreen API: https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/views/launch/splash-screen
- Investigation: `docs/investigations/20260321174500_investigation_empty_white_startup_screen.md`
- Related epics: fn-78 (established PackageInfo injection), fn-75 (dark-first route policy)

# fn-79-fix-empty-white-startup-screen.1 Make native launch surfaces dark on Android and iOS

## Description
Make all native launch surfaces dark (#030303) on both Android and iOS to match the Flutter `SplashScreen` background, eliminating the white flash on cold start.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `android/app/src/main/res/values/colors.xml` (create) — define `launch_background` color `#FF030303`
- `android/app/src/main/res/drawable/launch_background.xml` — change `@android:color/white` → `@color/launch_background`
- `android/app/src/main/res/drawable-v21/launch_background.xml` — change `?android:colorBackground` → `@color/launch_background`
- `android/app/src/main/res/drawable-night/launch_background.xml` (create) — same dark color for night mode
- `android/app/src/main/res/values/styles.xml` — change LaunchTheme + NormalTheme parent to `Theme.Black.NoTitleBar`
- `android/app/src/main/res/values-v31/styles.xml` (create) — `android:windowSplashScreenBackground` = `@color/launch_background`
- `android/app/src/main/res/values-night-v31/styles.xml` (create) — same for night mode
- `android/app/src/main/kotlin/.../MainActivity.kt` — add `setOnExitAnimationListener` for Android 12+ fade prevention
- `ios/Runner/Base.lproj/LaunchScreen.storyboard` — change white RGB → `red="0.012" green="0.012" blue="0.012"`
- `ios/Runner/Base.lproj/Main.storyboard` — change `white="1"` → matching dark color

## Approach

- Follow existing resource structure in `android/app/src/main/res/`
- Use `@color/launch_background` reference everywhere (DRY via `colors.xml`)
- Match Flutter `kitColors.background` at `lib/core/ui/constants/kit_colors.dart:472` — `Color(0xFF030303)`
- `values-night/styles.xml:4` already uses `Theme.Black.NoTitleBar` — just needs the drawable fixed
- `values-v31` LaunchTheme should inherit from base LaunchTheme and add the `android:windowSplashScreenBackground` attribute
- For iOS, use `colorSpace="custom" customColorSpace="sRGB"` format for exact color match

## Key context

- `drawable-v21/launch_background.xml:4` uses `?android:colorBackground` which resolves per theme — replace with explicit color ref
- Android 12+ ignores `windowBackground`; must use `windowSplashScreenBackground` in `values-v31`
- `setOnExitAnimationListener { it.remove() }` prevents the default 1s crossfade on Android 12+
- iOS caches launch screens aggressively — testing requires `flutter clean` + app reinstall
- `compileSdkVersion` resolves to 36 via Flutter toolchain; `minSdkVersion` 24 — `values-v31` resources will take effect on API 31+ devices
## Acceptance
- [ ] `values/colors.xml` defines `launch_background` as `#FF030303`
- [ ] `drawable/launch_background.xml` references `@color/launch_background` (not `@android:color/white`)
- [ ] `drawable-v21/launch_background.xml` references `@color/launch_background` (not `?android:colorBackground`)
- [ ] `drawable-night/launch_background.xml` exists with dark color
- [ ] `values/styles.xml` LaunchTheme and NormalTheme use `Theme.Black.NoTitleBar`
- [ ] `values-v31/styles.xml` sets `android:windowSplashScreenBackground`
- [ ] `values-night-v31/styles.xml` sets `android:windowSplashScreenBackground`
- [ ] `MainActivity.kt` calls `setOnExitAnimationListener` for API 31+
- [ ] `LaunchScreen.storyboard` background is dark (not white)
- [ ] `Main.storyboard` background is dark (not white)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] App builds and runs on both platforms without errors

# fn-79-fix-empty-white-startup-screen.2 Defer PackageInfo.fromPlatform() after runApp()

## Description
Remove `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` from pre-`runApp()` in `main()` and resolve it inside `StartupViewModel.initializeApp()` instead. This reduces the time users spend on the native launch surface before Flutter renders its first frame.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `lib/main.dart` — remove `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` await, remove `packageInfo` from `_AppLifecycleObserver` and `StartupView` constructor calls
- `lib/startup/startup_view.dart` — remove `packageInfo` constructor parameter, stop passing it to `StartupViewModel`
- `lib/startup/startup_view_model.dart` — remove `packageInfo` constructor parameter, await `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` at top of `initializeApp()`, pass result to `buildModules()`
- `lib/config/locator_config.dart` — no signature change needed (`buildModules` already takes `packageInfo` param)

## Approach

- Await `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` at the top of `initializeApp()` before calling `buildModules()` — this preserves the existing DI registration pattern where `buildModules` receives `packageInfo` as a parameter
- Remove `packageInfo` from the constructor chain: `main()` → `_AppLifecycleObserver` → `StartupView` → `StartupViewModel`
- The `retryInitialization()` path calls `locator.reset()` then `initializeApp()` again — `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` will be called again on retry, which is safe (it's a platform channel call that reads static data)
- `PackageInfo` is only consumed in `SettingsView` via `locator<PackageInfo>()` — it's accessed long after startup

## Key context

- fn-78 (commit `e6b041f`) added `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` before `runApp()` and threaded it through constructors — this change reverses that placement decision while keeping the DI registration
- `buildModules()` at `lib/config/locator_config.dart:62` takes `{required PackageInfo packageInfo}` — this signature stays the same
- `_AppLifecycleObserver` at `lib/main.dart` wraps `StartupView` — currently passes `packageInfo` through
- If `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` throws inside `initializeApp()`, the existing `try/catch` routes to `AppInitializationError` state with retry — this is acceptable behavior
- `locator_config.dart:65` registers PackageInfo as `lazy: false` — it is eagerly instantiated during `registerMany()`, so it must be available before that call
## Acceptance
- [ ] `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` is NOT awaited before `runApp()` in `main()`
- [ ] `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` is awaited inside `StartupViewModel.initializeApp()` before `buildModules()`
- [ ] `packageInfo` parameter removed from `_AppLifecycleObserver`, `StartupView`, and `StartupViewModel` constructors
- [ ] `buildModules()` still receives `packageInfo` as a named parameter (no signature change)
- [ ] `retryInitialization()` path still works (re-fetches PackageInfo on retry)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (update test mocks if constructor signatures changed)
